purpose: Minimize actual printed mass within functional, serviceability, fracture, stability and manufacturing constraints.

coordinates.X: Projection outward from the wall, mm
coordinates.Y: Installed vertical height, mm; rear rail center is Y=0
coordinates.Z: Across bracket width and printer build direction, mm

space_limits.underside_rule: At each X within the reference profile span, Y must be at least the reference's lowest material Y at that X minus 8 mm. Beyond the reference's forward tip, continue its final lower-limit height to X=215 mm.

spool_clearance.interpretation: Seated rigid-flange clearance only; loaded movement and insertion paths need separate checks. The guard conservatively covers the continuous diameter interval between samples.

functional_requirements.retention_geometry: May change; fit, capture, insertion force, strain and fatigue must be reverified rather than inherited.
functional_requirements.wall_contact: Contact must remain coplanar at X=0 and be sufficient for the solved load path; no requirement to preserve the old full-height strip.
functional_requirements.verification: These are functional targets, not frozen CAD masks. Candidate-specific contact, fit, mounting and retention checks are required.

density_helpers.placement_restriction: Any 3D placement; effective dense material is the union of helpers intersected with the printable body.
density_helpers.acceptance: Every emitted dense region must be checked against the selected density field. All printable mass, including walls, skins and automatic caps, is measured from actual sliced paths.

implementation_status: Spatial envelope builder and spatial checks supplied. The published G optimizer remains an immutable prior study; expanded shape/density search and new mechanical qualification have not run.
